desc: Implement the complete `permute` method: capped factorial precomputation, total-count early exit, helper `count_completions`, lexicographic position-by-position construction with k-subtraction, and returning [] on failure.
Edge-case handling: n=1, cases where no alternating permutations exist (|O−E| > 1), and large k beyond total count returning [] — all covered by the early-exit logic in the implementation.
